title: Reproducing inequality? Social capital, digital literacy, and SES in access to higher education
core_idea: This study investigates how social capital influences Chinese high school graduates' access to higher education within the context of digital transformation, focusing on interactions with digital literacy and socioeconomic status. Using survey data from 629 students across western, central, and eastern provinces, the authors employ regression and group regression analyses to assess mechanisms shaping learning opportunities.
tldr: Examines the roles of social capital, digital literacy, and SES in shaping Chinese students' access to higher education using survey-based regression analyses.
